mapper.select: SELECT FROM imp_arrival_difference WHERE ORDER BY difference_no, revision_no, id
SELECT FROM imp_arrival_difference WHERE ORDER BY difference_no, revision_no, id FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM imp_arrival_difference d JOIN imp_arrival_acceptance a ON a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND a.id = d.arrival_acceptance_id AND a.deleted = b'0' WHERE a.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND d.resolution_status = 'EXEMPTED' AND d.current_marker = 1 AND d.exemption_expires_at <= #{query.processingTime} AND d.deleted = b'0' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM imp_arrival_acceptance successor WHERE successor.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND successor.predecessor_acceptance_id = a.id AND successor.deleted = b'0' ) ORDER BY d.exemption_expires_at, d.tenant_id, d.arrival_acceptance_id, d.difference_no, d.revision_no, d.id LIMIT #{query.pageSize}

SELECT FROM imp_arrival_difference d JOIN imp_arrival_acceptance a ON a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND a.id = d.arrival_acceptance_id AND a.deleted = b'0' WHERE d.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND a.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND a.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND d.resolution_status = 'EXEMPTED' AND d.current_marker = 1 AND d.approved_by IS NOT NULL AND d.approved_at IS NOT NULL AND d.evidence_id IS NOT NULL AND d.evidence_revision IS NOT NULL AND d.exemption_expires_at > #{query.checkedAt} AND d.deleted = b'0' ORDER BY d.arrival_line_id, d.difference_no, d.revision_no, d.id

SELECT FROM imp_arrival_difference d JOIN imp_arrival_acceptance a ON a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND a.id = d.arrival_acceptance_id AND a.deleted = b'0' WHERE d.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND a.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND a.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND d.resolution_status = 'EXEMPTED' AND d.current_marker = 1 AND d.approved_by IS NOT NULL AND d.approved_at IS NOT NULL AND d.evidence_id IS NOT NULL AND d.evidence_revision IS NOT NULL AND d.exemption_expires_at > #{query.checkedAt} AND d.deleted = b'0' ORDER BY d.arrival_line_id, d.difference_no, d.revision_no, d.id FOR UPDATE

SELECT d.project_fact_version, 'DIFFERENCE' AS source_type, d.id AS source_id, d.arrival_acceptance_id AS acceptance_id, a.predecessor_acceptance_id FROM imp_arrival_difference d JOIN imp_arrival_acceptance a ON a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND a.id = d.arrival_acceptance_id AND a.deleted = b'0' WHERE d.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND a.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND d.project_fact_version IS NOT NULL AND d.deleted = b'0' ORDER BY d.project_fact_version DESC, d.id LIMIT 2 FOR UPDATE
